name: Clozapine
summary: Clozapine is an atypical antipsychotic used in treatment-resistant schizophrenia.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Extensively metabolized through CYP1A2, CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, including demethylation, hydroxylation and N-oxidation. Norclozapine has pharmacological activity. Metabolites leave through urine and feces.
